title: How Food-Obsessed Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Food personality!

questions.text: When it comes to dining out, you prefer...

options.text: Choosing a familiar spot you’ve been to many times, knowing you’ll love the food
Going to a popular restaurant with a group of friends, chatting and sharing dishes
Trying a newly opened restaurant with a creative menu you’ve never seen before
Visiting a quiet, cozy café alone, savoring the meal in peace

questions.text: When planning meals for the week, you...

options.text: Focus on nutrition balance and ingredient quality
Decide based on what your family members have been craving lately
Wing it, picking ingredients based on what looks fresh at the market that day
Write a detailed menu and shopping list to avoid last-minute stress

questions.text: Trying a new cuisine for the first time, you feel...

options.text: Curious but cautious, asking the server for recommendations first
Excited to dive in, ordering the most unique dish on the menu
Eager to bring a friend along to share the experience
Comfortable exploring alone, taking time to savor each bite

questions.text: When evaluating a dish, you focus more on...

options.text: How it makes you feel—nostalgic, happy, or comforted
Whether it meets your expectations for flavor and presentation
The creativity of the chef and unexpected flavor combinations
The technical skill—cooking time, temperature, and ingredient quality
Cooking a childhood favorite recipe that reminds you of home
Experimenting with a new recipe from a foreign cookbook
Hosting a potluck with friends, trying everyone’s homemade dishes
Enjoying a slow, solo brunch at a quiet corner café

questions.text: At the grocery store, you tend to...

options.text: Stick to your list, buying only what’s needed for the week
Wander the aisles, picking up interesting ingredients that catch your eye
Choose trusted brands and seasonal produce you’ve used before
Grab exotic fruits or spices you’ve never cooked with before

questions.text: When you find a great dish, you...

options.text: Tell all your friends about it, convincing them to try it too
Keep it as your little secret, returning to enjoy it alone
Analyze the recipe, trying to recreate it at home step by step
Feel warm knowing others might love it as much as you do
Follow the recipe exactly, measuring ingredients to the gram
Adjust seasonings on the fly, trusting your taste buds
Use traditional methods passed down from family
Incorporate modern techniques like sous vide or foam toppings
Scheduled—you eat at the same times every day
Flexible—you eat when you’re hungry, no set schedule
Social—you often eat with family or colleagues
Private—you prefer eating alone to recharge

questions.text: A dish becomes your favorite because...

options.text: It brings back memories of a special moment or person
It’s nutritionally balanced and prepared with care
It’s a classic you’ve loved since childhood
It blends flavors from different cultures in a unique way
Plan meals to avoid leftovers in the first place
Turn them into a new dish, like a stir-fry or wrap
Reheat them as they are, enjoying the original flavor
Add new spices or sauces to give them a fresh twist

questions.text: To learn about new foods, you prefer to...

options.text: Talk to chefs at food festivals and ask for tips
Watch documentaries or read articles about global cuisines
Research the science behind ingredients and cooking methods
Listen to friends share stories about their favorite meals

results.title: The Nostalgic Home Cook
results.description: Food for you is a bridge to the past. You cherish family recipes, childhood flavors, and the comfort of familiar dishes. You prefer cooking at home, using methods passed down through generations, and find joy in sharing these meals with loved ones. Your food personality is warm, grounded, and deeply connected to tradition. You're an ISFJ—nurturing, reliable, and the heart of every family meal.

results.title: The Curious Food Explorer
results.description: You live to taste the world. From street food in Bangkok to fusion restaurants in Paris, you’re always seeking new flavors and culinary adventures. You love experimenting with exotic ingredients and sharing your discoveries with anyone who’ll listen. Your food personality is energetic, open-minded, and endlessly curious. You're an ENFP—spontaneous, enthusiastic, and forever hungry for the next bite.

results.title: The Analytical Food Critic
results.description: You approach food like a science. You evaluate dishes based on technique, ingredient quality, and balance, breaking down what works and what doesn’t. You enjoy cooking with precision, following recipes to the letter, and are quick to spot flaws in a meal. Your food personality is sharp, detail-oriented, and unapologetically honest. You're an INTJ—strategic, critical, and always striving for culinary perfection.

results.title: The Social Feast Organizer
results.description: Meals are about connection for you. You thrive on hosting dinner parties, organizing potlucks, and turning meals into memorable events. You love trying new restaurants with friends and believe the best food is shared. Your food personality is outgoing, generous, and the life of every table. You're an ESFJ—sociable, caring, and dedicated to making every meal a celebration.

results.title: The Creative Food Innovator
results.description: You see food as a canvas. You’re always mixing flavors, experimenting with techniques, and turning leftovers into masterpieces. Traditional recipes bore you—you’d rather add a unexpected twist, like matcha in pasta or chili in chocolate. Your food personality is imaginative, bold, and unafraid to take risks. You're an ENTP—clever, innovative, and the ultimate kitchen rebel.

results.title: The Quiet Food Connoisseur
results.description: You savor food in solitude. You prefer small, intimate restaurants or home-cooked meals where you can focus on the flavors without distraction. You remember every dish you’ve loved, from a simple bowl of soup to a gourmet tasting menu, and value quality over quantity. Your food personality is reflective, discerning, and deeply connected to the sensory experience of eating. You're an INFP—sensitive, introspective, and a true lover of life’s quiet culinary joys.

results.title: The Practical Meal Planner
results.description: You approach food with logic and purpose. You plan meals weeks in advance, shop with a list, and prioritize nutrition and efficiency. You’re a master of meal prepping, turning simple ingredients into balanced, delicious dishes. Your food personality is organized, reliable, and focused on making the most of every ingredient. You're an ISTJ—practical, responsible, and the king/queen of the weekly meal plan.

results.title: The Adaptive Food Adventurer
results.description: You go with the flow when it comes to food. You’re just as happy eating a food truck taco as a five-star meal, and you never plan where to eat—you let your mood (or a friend’s suggestion) guide you. You love trying whatever’s in season and即兴 cooking with whatever’s in the fridge. Your food personality is flexible, easygoing, and always up for a surprise. You're an ESFP—spontaneous, fun-loving, and the life of any impromptu meal.

results.title: The Compassionate Food Nurturer
results.description: You cook with love, and it shows. You remember everyone’s favorite dishes, adjust recipes to accommodate dietary needs, and believe food is a way to care for others. You’re happiest when you’re feeding someone, whether it’s a sick friend or a crowd at a potluck. Your food personality is warm, empathetic, and deeply generous. You're an INFJ—insightful, caring, and the person everyone turns to for comfort food.

results.title: The Bold Flavor Seeker
results.description: You crave intensity in every bite. Spicy curries, tangy fermented foods, rich desserts—you love flavors that make your taste buds wake up. You’re not afraid to try the “weird” dish on the menu, and you’re always pushing your palate to new limits. Your food personality is adventurous, confident, and unapologetically bold. You're an ESTP—energetic, daring, and always ready to take on the next flavor challenge.

results.title: The Detail-Oriented Chef
results.description: You treat cooking like a craft. You measure ingredients precisely, time each step carefully, and presentation matters just as much as taste. You’re always refining your skills, taking classes, and perfecting classic recipes until they’re flawless. Your food personality is meticulous, patient, and dedicated to excellence. You're an ISTP—hands-on, precise, and a true master of the kitchen.

results.title: The Visionary Food Futurist
results.description: You’re obsessed with the future of food. You follow food tech trends, experiment with plant-based meats, and imagine new ways to make food more sustainable and exciting. You love molecular gastronomy, lab-grown ingredients, and reimagining traditional dishes for the modern world. Your food personality is forward-thinking, innovative, and always ahead of the curve. You're an ENFJ—visionary, inspiring, and passionate about changing the world through food.

results.title: The Minimalist Food Lover
results.description: Less is more for you. You appreciate simple, high-quality ingredients—olive oil, fresh bread, ripe tomatoes—and let them shine without fancy preparation. You prefer small plates, seasonal dishes, and meals that feel light and intentional. Your food personality is calm, mindful, and deeply connected to the essence of food. You're an INTP—contemplative, minimalist, and a lover of understated culinary perfection.

results.title: The Traditional Food Guardian
results.description: You’re the keeper of culinary heritage. You learn family recipes by heart, preserve traditional cooking methods, and believe in honoring the past through food. You’re skeptical of “trendy” dishes and prefer the comfort of what’s been passed down for generations. Your food personality is loyal, grounded, and deeply respectful of tradition. You're an ISFP—gentle, observant, and the guardian of your culture’s culinary legacy.

results.title: The Strategic Food Optimizer
results.description: You approach food like a puzzle. You maximize flavor while minimizing waste, turn leftovers into new meals, and plan menus that balance taste, cost, and nutrition. You’re always looking for ways to make cooking more efficient, whether it’s prepping ingredients on Sundays or using a slow cooker for busy weeknights. Your food personality is logical, resourceful, and focused on results. You're an ESTJ—organized, efficient, and the ultimate food strategist.

results.title: The Free-Spirited Food Wanderer
results.description: You let your taste buds lead the way. You never stick to a single cuisine, preferring to mix and match flavors from around the world. You cook without recipes, relying on intuition and whatever ingredients inspire you that day. You’re just as happy eating a sandwich from a gas station as a fancy meal, as long as it feels authentic. Your food personality is free-spirited, open, and endlessly curious. You're an INTP—unconventional, imaginative, and a true wanderer of the culinary world.
